First official public release of deltabreedquery. This matches the package [as it was accepted to CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/deltabreedquery/index.html).

All core functions now have runnable examples using prepackaged sample data.

Tested and working with both production-level DeltaBreed instances (anything at app.breedinginsight.net), as well as pre-release instances used internally by Breeding Insight.

[Release on GitHub](https://github.com/Breeding-Insight/deltabreedquery/releases/tag/v1.0.3) · [About deltabreedquery](../software/deltabreedquery.qmd)
